keyword: silver portfolio allocation beginner vs advanced
angle: How beginner precious metals investors should size silver allocation conservatively (5-10%) while advanced investors can push toward 15-20% based on current 2025-2026 market data.
secondary_kw: how much silver should I own

stats.claim: Silver Institute forecasts the silver market will post a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit in 2026, projected at 46.3 million ounces
Industrial and technology applications accounted for roughly 61% of total global silver demand in 2025, up from 53% a decade earlier
Global coin and bar (physical investment) demand rose 14% in 2025, supported by a 33% jump in Indian physical investment
Financial advisors increasingly recommend a 5-15% total precious metals allocation, a shift from the traditional 5% ceiling, with conservative investors at 5-10% and aggressive investors up to 15-20%
The 20-year average gold-to-silver ratio sits near 70:1, with the ratio compressing from above 100 in April 2025 toward roughly 55-62 by June 2026 as silver outperformed
Silver industrial fabrication is forecast to decline 2% in 2026 to about 650 Moz, with AI data centers and automotive demand partially offsetting weaker solar PV usage
